description: Free-to-play 2D multiplayer build-and-fight game from Transhuman Design. Installs through Steam (app 219830) or as the standalone client from kag2d.com.
notes: Steam or standalone: if Steam is installed, 'scoop install' asks whether to install the game through Steam
(Y/Enter, or no answer within 30 seconds) or as the standalone client (N). Without Steam it installs the standalone client.
To choose without the question (e.g. in UniGetUI), run $env:GESU_KAG_SOURCE = 'steam' or 'standalone' first.
The choice is kept for 'scoop update'; a new 'scoop install' asks again.
Through Steam: Steam's install dialog opens and Steam downloads and updates the game; 'scoop uninstall' asks Steam to remove it.
Standalone: portable, unpacked from the official MSI (no admin rights). The game updates itself from kag2d.com on start,
and keeps its settings (*.cfg) and screenshots in its own folder, so the whole folder is persisted:
$persist_dir\KAG survives updates and 'scoop uninstall'; 'scoop uninstall --purge' deletes it.
Multiplayer needs a free kag2d.com account (Steam users get one automatically).
The 'King-Arthurs-Gold' command and the 'King Arthur's Gold' shortcut in Scoop Apps start the chosen copy.
pre_install: # The kag2d.com installer (outside Scoop) would be a second copy, and its uninstaller deletes its whole folder.

$msiCopy = Get-ChildItem $roots -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.PSChildName -notlike 'Steam App *' } | Get-ItemProperty -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.DisplayName -eq "King Arthur's Gold" } | Select-Object -First 1

if ($msiCopy) { error "King Arthur's Gold is already installed from kag2d.com's installer ($($msiCopy.InstallLocation)). Remove it first in Settings > Apps; its uninstaller deletes that whole folder, so copy your *.cfg files and Screenshots out of it first if you need them."; break }

script: # Where the game comes from, first match wins: the variable, the earlier choice (update only), Steam's copy, no Steam, the question.
if (!$source -and $inSteam) { $source = 'steam'; info "King Arthur's Gold is already installed in Steam; Scoop keeps track of that copy." }
# One key press; Enter or no answer within 30 seconds means Steam. Without a console (input redirected) the default is used at once.
Write-Host "Steam is installed. Install King Arthur's Gold through Steam? [Y/n] " -ForegroundColor Yellow -NoNewline
if ($source -notin 'steam', 'standalone') { error "GESU_KAG_SOURCE must be 'steam' or 'standalone', not '$source'."; break }
if (($source -eq 'steam') -and !$steamExe) { error 'Steam is not installed. Install it first (scoop install extras/steam), sign in, then try again; or install the standalone client.'; break }
# The command behind 'bin' and the shortcut, written for the chosen copy.
'steam' = @(':: Starts King Arthur''s Gold through Steam (app 219830).', 'START "" "steam://rungameid/219830"')
'standalone' = @(':: Starts the standalone King Arthur''s Gold client; it updates itself from kag2d.com first.', 'START "" /D "%~dp0KAG" "%~dp0KAG\KAG.exe" %*')
$lines = @('@ECHO OFF') + $launchers[$source][0] + ':: Written by the King-Arthurs-Gold package of the gesu Scoop bucket.' + $launchers[$source][1] + ''
# An earlier standalone copy in persist already has the newest files (it updates itself): keep it, drop the unpacked one.
# Steam keeps its own copy: drop the unpacked client ('persist' then links an empty KAG folder).
Write-Host "Steam opened its install dialog for King Arthur's Gold: choose a library there. The download continues in Steam." -ForegroundColor Yellow
if ($source -ne 'steam') { info "The standalone game stays in $persist_dir\KAG; 'scoop uninstall --purge' deletes it."; return }
Write-Host "Steam asks you to confirm removing King Arthur's Gold; the game files are deleted only after you confirm." -ForegroundColor Yellow
# The download URL has no version, and the game updates itself; use the date THD published the MSI.
# kag2d.com sometimes drops a connection, so retry with a fresh one each time.
